k-anthropic.title: Anthropic IPO day $ANT coins
k-anthropic.sourceSays: Posts say Anthropic went public on Nov 19 as $ANT, with Kalshi and others reporting an indicated opening above the IPO price; separate posts say $ANTHROPIC went live on Bags.
k-anthropic.reason: Posts of Nov 19 describe the Anthropic IPO and its opening; coin pools opened 0.2-2.9h ago, same day. Whether the coins are tied to the company is unverified.
